labels: Occupancy, callback begin, callback separate, callback-active end, impact response (incoming normal speed < -0.2 m/s and positive impulse), support response otherwise. Independent binary labels can coexist. Ordered callbacks retained; no bounded-event truncation.

cells.E0: Event labels and explicit own-contact geometry
cells.E1: E0 plus causal active-at-start episode bit
cells.E2: E1 plus competing-surface time, first/second gap, and missing masks

training: First 200 exact-state updates with balanced per-output conditional losses, then 100 full-release updates with model-generated episode history and fixed analytic physical states. Shared local encoder/head sizes and initialization. Evaluate after both fixed stages, no checkpoint selection.
physics: Unchanged earliest-surface analytic integrator in every event cell. Event readouts do not scale impulses. This stage tests event representation, not improved mechanics or decision success.
support: Report independent parent support and natural prevalence; validate on new matching strata, not a claim about ordinary generator prevalence.
numerical_audit: First parent of each stratum in each split, three edits, 1920/3840 Hz; retain sensitive branches.
promotion: No demo checkpoint replacement. Integration and tolerance selection are separate studies. No learned mechanical residual before event evidence.
